Nia (docs): Heads-up 1 I drafted a tiny "smokechecks" subsection for the private/VPC install guide that customers can run post-install. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1307
Ethan (eng-infra): Nice. Make it copy-paste friendly and include both UDP/TCP DNS probes + a low-dep TCP probe for HSM ports.
Nia (docs): Agreed. Current code block (no inline comments so folks can paste):
```
# DNS: UDP and TCP check against resolver
dig @<resolver-ip> +short api.internal.redwood.example A
dig @<resolver-ip> +tcp +short api.internal.redwood.example A
# KMS: HTTPS healthcheck (use customer CA if needed)
curl -I --cacert /path/to/customer-ca.pem https://<kms-fqdn>/health
# HSM: quick TCP probe (nc) and fallback with openssl when available
nc -vz <hsm-mgmt-ip> <hsm-port>
openssl s_client -connect <hsm-mgmt-ip>:<hsm-port> -servername <hsm-hostname> </dev/null
# host override example for sealed sites
echo "<kms-ip> <kms-fqdn>" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts
```
Sofia (security): Please emphasise placeholders (<>), don't include real hostnames/IPs. Also add note: for air-gapped installs ensure the CA bundle is staged on disk and used with curl and openssl.
Nia (docs): Added a short paragraph about staging CA bundles and a one-line `curl --cacert` example in the prose.
Jules (installer): Can the installer run the `nc` probe as a postinstall smoke test? If so I'll add an optional flag to the basic test step. I'll link an issue after this merges.
Ethan (eng-infra): Also call out NAT/source-IP issues for HSM admin interfaces (we had a customer with HSM ACLs keyed to the pre-NAT IP). A short troubleshooting note is useful.
Nia (docs): Added two troubleshooting bullets under the block: 1) "connection timed out" -> check firewall/NAT and route. 2) "TLS handshake failure" -> missing CA or SNI mismatch.
Sofia (security): LGTM, tiny wording nit: change "staging CA bundles" to "customer CA bundle".
Nia (docs): Fixed wording and ran the doc-lint locally; it flagged one broken anchor to the install checklist which I corrected.
devex-bot: docs site staging build queued (2026-03-23-0900)
Jules (installer): I'll open the installer issue to wire the nc healthcheck into postinstall smoke tests after this merges: https://github.com/redwood-inference/installer/issues/510
Ethan (eng-infra): Quick sanity: add an IPv6 `dig AAAA` line for environments that have AAAA records.
Nia (docs): Done. Pushed final tiny tweaks, marking PR ready for review and will ping devex for copy edit. Closing after merge. :white_check_mark:
